AZR_PRODUCTION_CORE.text: AZURE REACH PRODUCTION CORE — Bright, glossy, well-funded contemporary marine park with luminous public spaces, polished glass-and-stone architecture, clean professional backstage areas and credible working habitats. Animals remain calm and behaviorally credible. Released Azure Reach Issue 1 is strict visual canon for established faces, apparent ages, body proportions, department color coding, facility design and overall rendering language; do not redesign established people or make backstage areas grimy, improvised or industrially degraded. WONDER-FIRST VISUAL HIERARCHY: when a page contains a living habitat, animal encounter, underwater vista, garden, or other guest-facing Azure Reach experience, the comic reader must be allowed to see why it is beautiful, desirable or fascinating before the institutional complication takes over. Plot machinery may intrude on the experience, but it must not accidentally become more visually important than the thing the characters are trying to protect, sell, interpret, measure, film or organize. In-world cameras, phones, dashboards, counters, signs, queues and screens are story props, not default reader framing; when a diegetic camera misses an animal or a metric misses the point, the comic composition may and often should give the reader the better view. Guest-facing frames should make Azure Reach genuinely desirable and spectacular through scale, animal beauty, discovery, quiet, color and specific human wonder. When a page is built around awe, give the habitat or animal real page area and let reaction carry the beat instead of filling the page with institutional explanation. Backstage and procedural pages should remain visually connected to the living park whenever geography permits so the work never seems more important than what the work serves.

AZR_LETTERING.text: LETTERING — Use clean professional integrated comic lettering. Preserve exact dialogue, captions, and scripted signage; keep balloon order and speaker attribution unambiguous; never invent, duplicate, omit, or corrupt text. Compose art with intentional room for lettering.

AZR_VIS_BRINE.text: BRINE SQUAD VISUAL — Dark navy / black-blue technical workwear with cyan functional accents, radios and practical gear; sturdy, work-ready silhouettes; no hot pink.

AZR_VIS_GUEST_RELATIONS.text: GUEST RELATIONS VISUAL — Lighter blue / teal hospitality wear; tablet, badge, headset or small radio where appropriate; neat, approachable, mobile, socially open; no Finfluencer glamour.

AZR_VIS_FINFLUENCERS.text: FINFLUENCER VISUAL — Camera-ready azure uniforms with hot-pink status accents, polished branded silhouettes and content gear. Julian and Fleur read as public-facing stars; Kyler reads as media support.

AZR_VIS_CORPORATE.text: CORPORATE VISUAL — Pale blue / slate tailored executive wear, structured silhouettes, minimal accessories, polished and expensive rather than flashy.

AZR_VIS_MAYA_PIP_SEPARATION.text: MAYA / PIP SEPARATION — Maya is dark-navy Brine Squad: practical dark hair, technical radio/utility gear, guarded posture. Pip is lighter blue/teal Guest Relations: tablet/headset/badge, warmer expression, animated posture. Do not merge their face, hair, silhouette, palette, props, or body language.

AZR_E02_CONTINUITY.text: ISSUE 2 VISUAL CONTINUITY — Dolphin scenes use the established luminous public gallery and clean care-backstage language, approved trainer objects and controlled keeper return points where scripted. Guests remain behind public barriers; no guest handling, throwing, backstage access or altered animal behavior. Dolphins remain calm and behaviorally credible.

AZR_CONSERVATION_WEEK_STATE.text: CONSERVATION WEEK STATE — While the campaign is active, keep its passports, signage and relevant carried materials consistent where they appear. Each gallery keeps its own local crowd flow, queue geometry and physical geography rather than inheriting the previous page's positions.

AZR_EDITORIAL_SPLASH.text: EDITORIAL SPLASH — Full-page atmospheric editorial frontispiece or teaser. Use one dominant cinematic image with generous intentional negative space for exact integrated caption copy. The art should sell wonder, tension, and forward motion without depicting plot resolution. No speech balloons, no visible editor, no infographic or dossier layout. Preserve Azure Reach’s released bright aquatic palette, glossy high-end architecture, natural animal behavior, and prestige comic rendering. Typography should feel like finished editorial comic design rather than pasted-on marketing copy.
